liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Jerry is described as taking four huge turns, getting higher and higher; The reviewer calls the transition into Fire on the Mountain the finest example heard [15][17]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): The reviewer calls this performance their favorite version of the song of all time [15]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): The reviewer states this version of the song is a personal favorite [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-09-02.131868.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 195 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd78-09-02.rolfe.weiner.15822.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 195 min; rated 3.56/5 by 18 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording has no editing between songs, leaving long empty periods; The band is barely audible at times due to the audience recording quality; The non-editing of the tape makes it feel like an actual live show [14][16]
- **gd1978-09-02.sbd.miller.106818.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Set 2 sounds significantly better than Set 1, with improved pitch correction [3]
- **gd1978-09-02.aud-sbd.clugston.5986.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 172 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd1978-09-02.164506.fob.shure.sm57.gatto.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1644**: audience recording; 19 songs; 185 min [5]
- **gd78-09-02.sbd.jools.7925.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 159 min; rated 4.3/5 by 54 [6]. Said about its sound: Notes are described as melting out of Jerry's guitar throughout the song; The second set is described as blazing with energy and having good sound [13][19]

## Around the show

- Bobby's raps are described as beautiful, bringing immense joy to the listener [15]
- The reviewer claims Jerry had no emotion, showing a poker face during the show [20]
- The crowd was disappointed the drums were short, suspecting the band was joking [21]
- New Riders of the Purple Sage and Willie Nelson are listed as other artists [1]
- The performance is considered perfect in its own right, though not necessarily better than others [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-09-02.131868.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:106818) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Adobe Audition… [1]
- **gd78-09-02.rolfe.weiner.15822.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording: Sony EMC-33Ps [2]
- **gd1978-09-02.sbd.miller.106818.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [3]
- **gd1978-09-02.aud-sbd.clugston.5986.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Master Audience Cassette; Shure SM-57 mics> Sony TC-158 Master Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT source supplies the 2nd set [4]
- **gd1978-09-02.164506.fob.shure.sm57.gatto.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Keith Gatto; transferred by Tim McKenzie;Charlie Miller;Scott Clugston; source: Keith Gatto's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics> Sony TC-158 > Tim McKenzies' DAT (x3)(Maxell HS-4/90s) @48kHz [5]. Also: Steve Rolfe and Noah Weiner provided a Sony ECM-33P source for patches [5]
- **gd78-09-02.sbd.jools.7925.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead & Willie Nelson Giants Stadium 1978 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-willie-nelson-giants-stadium-1978) [24]
